results.title: Responsive, four languages, coverage, RTL (4 widths x 4 languages x 7 views)
results.evidence: 112 captures (1440/1024/768/390 x en/de/fr/ar x pricing table, Go live dialog of Lab Draft Class (Draft), Retire dialog of Business, open Retired list, Chauffeurs, booking detail VT-26-0001, public /about), metrics in s9-metrics.json. PASS parts: scrollWidth <= innerWidth on all 112; dir=rtl on every Arabic capture and ltr on the others; both dialogs fit the viewport at every size (no inner scroll needed); no clipped DRAFT/LIVE badge at 390 (inside cell and cell; text fits); class names carry unicode-bidi:isolate. FAIL parts: (1) VamosLocale.coverage(document.body) is NOT 0 on any dashboard capture (96 of 96): Pricing 24 en / 21 de / 30 fr / 28 ar, Chauffeurs 25-26, booking detail 11-15; it is 0 on /about (16 of 16). The strings flagged include shell and older page strings (Content, Collapse sidebar, Lab Admin, admin, Actions, Discard draft, Publish fare book, Class, Start, Hide from public, Shown on public, '4 classes', 'Who drives, in which class, and on which plate'), so the brief's body-wide 0 cannot hold on the dashboard; scoped to the open dialog coverage is 0 in 24 of 32 dialog captures and 1 in the 8 de/fr Go live captures ('Erledigt' / 'Fait', the screen-reader word for Done). (2) At 390 the badge sits beside a short name (LIVE next to Economy/Business/Van luxury) and wraps under only a long name (DRAFT under Lab Draft Class); it is never clipped. (3) Arabic: on the booking detail the reference VT-26-0001 has computed direction rtl and unicode-bidi normal (no isolate / vt-dir-keep class on its span); on Chauffeurs the plate and licence cells are direction rtl with unicode-bidi isolate; how they render was not read from a picture.

results.title: No yellow glow / pale yellow on new elements (1440 and 390)
results.evidence: Computed styles in s10-metrics.json (43 rows at 1440, 42 at 390; base, hover, Tab focus, press) for DRAFT badge, LIVE badge, Retire icon, Retired head (closed and open), Retired list, Bring back, Go live dialog (Edit class, disabled Go live), Retire dialog (Cancel, Retire), red flag on Chauffeurs, left-out line on booking detail. Pale yellow or cream background/border/text: none. Blurred halo: none; the only blur is the neutral charcoal dialog shadow rgba(17,18,18,0.18) 0 24px 64px. FAIL against the brief's literal rule: on Tab focus (and on press while focus stays) six interactive elements (DRAFT badge button, Retired head, Bring back, Edit class, Retire-dialog Cancel, and the Retired head while open) carry box-shadow rgba(253,194,11,0.45) 0 0 0 3px, a solid 3px yellow ring. It is the design-system --vt-ring (design-system/tokens/elevation.css line 15, applied by base.css 'button:focus-visible'), which the project rules list as allowed on focus, so the brief and CLAUDE.md disagree; no hover state has a ring except where focus was kept. LIVE badge has tabindex -1 so Tab does not reach it (by design); the disabled Go live and the Retire/Retire-icon buttons showed no ring.
